description.narrative: In Silba Egypt we are working to establish a new partnership with Ambassadors for Dialogue Egypt (AFD), which will be building on our shared experiences of being partners in DUF’s Ambassadors for Dialogue project. As the current program is ending in the summer of 2023, the new organization Ambassadors for Dialogue Egypt will be created, and we wish to build on all the experiences and knowledge gained from more than 10 years of dialogue work in our new partnership. During our partner identification trip, we wish to explore whether a partnership between Silba and AFD Egypt could be beneficial by focusing on the vision of the new organization and by experiencing and participating in AFD’s current work on the ground. By the end of the trip, we expect to have a partnership agreement that will form the foundation for our further work at the Partner seminar in Haslev at the end of April.
